name: Blue Sky Marathon & Half Marathon

location.name: Fort Collins, CO
location.address: Blue Sky Trailhead, Horsetooth Mountain Park, Fort Collins, Colorado

description: Trail running race taking place on the trails between Horsetooth Mountain Park and Devil's Backbone Open Space. The Blue Sky courses offer a north-south tour of the easternmost hogbacks of Northern Colorado's Front Range mountains. The 100% dirt course is 90% sweet Colorado singletrack with terrain ranging from smooth dirt trail to technical rock gardens. Marathon: 22mi dirt singletrack, 3mi rocky singletrack, 2mi dirt road with 3,500' elevation gain. Half Marathon: 13.0mi dirt singletrack, 0.5mi dirt road with 1,800' elevation gain. Elevation range: 5,300'-6,500'. Time allowances: 9 hours (Marathon) / 6 hours (Half Marathon). Registration cap: 400 per distance.

name: Weekend at Burney Run/Walk/Crawl
description: Weekend at Burney Run/Walk/Crawl is a laid-back, high-fun trail event featuring a 4.8-mile looped course with 370 ft elevation gain per loop. The event offers multiple timed options (48-hour, 24-hour, 12-hour challenges) with a 50/50 mix of single-track and dirt service road terrain. Participants can run, walk, crawl, or participate in the burro race. Cash prizes awarded for most miles, with belt buckles for 100+ mile finishers and special ultra buckles for 100+ mile finishers in 24 hours. All participants completing loops earn medals.
